coverage_summary: Reviewed all 16 trajectories. Stage 0 opacity, HCA preprocessing uncertainty, lookup port bindings, T0b mask replacement, and evaluation-path reuse are generally supported. Several documented prompt, lookup/projector, virtual-token injection, and drug-target branches are missing or left too opaque.

findings.detail: The HCA Stage-II step bypasses the documented prompt-construction transformation and outputs directly to the backbone boundary. The existing text_prompt node is therefore orphaned.

evidence.quote: Each prompt has four blocks: (1) KG virtual tokens [KG_VT] ... (2) Biological metadata [Meta] ... (3) Cell Sentence [CellSentence] ... (4) Task instruction [Task]
The same skeleton serves classification, free-generation annotation, and drug-response tasks through the same interface.

findings.required_change: Represent the documented textual serialization as a serialize call producing text_prompt, followed by the unresolved tokenizer/backbone boundary; keep KG-token injection as a separate branch.

findings.detail: The GRPO prompt-preparation step combines serialization, tokenization, and backbone preparation into an opaque boundary even though the paper supplies the four-block prompt structure and a concrete B1 prompt example.

evidence.quote: T0b is a sequence-prior task: given a Cell Sentence with ∼ 15% of gene symbols replaced by <mask> tokens, the model generates the masked gene identities from the surrounding ranked-gene context.
